title: reporting.report_generated.v1 payload
description: Payload of reporting.report_generated.v1 (aggregate: report_run). Emitted when a report is run and its immutable snapshot is recorded. The envelope aggregateId equals the report run id.

reportKey.description: Catalogue key of the report that was run, e.g. finance.pl.

rowCount.description: Number of rows in the recorded snapshot.

checksum.description: SHA-256 over the report key, parameters, rows, and summary.
